newsitem.title: USA: Gimmicky US budget would hurt markets -- Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Gimmicky US budget would hurt markets -- Greenspan.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan said on Tuesday that financial markets would probably react negatively if Congress passed a budget that was perceived as using gimmicks to reach balance.
That in turn would likely affect the central bank's approach to monetary policy, he told the House Budget Committee, without being more specific.
"I can't say in advance what the appropriate monetary policy would be under those conditions," he added.
